headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 12, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a crucial win over the Cleveland Guardians, while the Miami Marlins shut down the Pittsburgh Pirates in a 2-0 victory. The Chicago Cubs took down the Washington Nationals 8-6, and the New York Yankees edged out the Seattle Mariners 4-1.

Top MLB news saw the Tigers edge out the Guardians 6-4, with Chase DeLauter leading the Guardians' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance. The Marlins secured a shutout win over the Pirates, with Eury Pérez pitching 7.0 innings and allowing 0 earned runs. Esteury Ruiz led the Marlins' offense with a home run and 1 RBI. The Cubs secured an 8-6 victory over the Nationals, with Seiya Suzuki leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Jacob Webb earned the save with 1.1 scoreless innings, striking out 2 batters.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Los Angeles Dodgers right-handed pitcher Blake Treinen has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. Boston Red Sox second baseman Isiah Kiner-Falefa has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list. New York Yankees right-handed pitcher Kervin Castro has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 10, 2026, due to right elbow neuritis. Cincinnati Reds right-handed pitcher Hunter Greene has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow soreness.

Several teams have made roster moves in recent days. The Kansas City Royals acquired first baseman Jacob Berry in a trade. The Athletics traded right-handed pitcher Seth Johnson to the Athletics for right fielder Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded right-handed pitcher Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for right-handed pitcher Brandan Bidois, left fielder Brian Sanchez, and infielder Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded right-handed pitcher Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for first baseman Connor Norby and right-handed pitcher Aiden May.
